question: In July 1968, Indira Gandhi, the then Prime Minister of India, officially recorded impressive strides of the Green Revolution in agriculture by releasing a special stamp entitled _________.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Wheat Revolution**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Context**: India faced frequent food shortages in the 1960s.
 
• **Green Revolution: **__A government initiative to increase agricultural production through:
 __
 
• High-yielding varieties of wheat and rice seeds.
 
• Improved irrigation infrastructure.
 
• Use of fertilizers and pesticides.
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi's Role:**__
 __
 
• Prime Minister during the Green Revolution's peak.
 
• Championed the initiative, providing subsidies and support to farmers.
 
• **Stamp Release (July 1968):**__ "Wheat Revolution" stamp to mark the success of wheat production increase.
 
 

__**Impact**__:

 
• Increased wheat production, leading to India achieving self-sufficiency in food grains by the 1980s.
 
• Reduced dependence on food imports.
 
• However, the Green Revolution also had drawbacks like environmental concerns and widening social inequalities.
